mobbin:9b7b370a-b591-4494-b083-228f11e6f.summary: From My Library the user picks a create path, lands in an empty step editor with import/capture sources, fills a captured step plus metadata, configures Preview player chrome, then reviews Insights engagement and step drop-off funnels.
steps: How would you like to get started?
Empty editor — Add from / Capture with
Preview — layout, logo, CTA, feature toggles
steal: Create chooser with Popular badge grouping related capture paths (Chrome Extension / Desktop App) vs upload vs video→demo (step 2).
Empty-step dual catalog: Add from (computer / Library / another demo) vs Capture with (extension / desktop / Figma) on the canvas (step 3).
Edit | Preview | Insights tabs keep authoring, learner view, and completion funnel in one project (steps 4–8).
Performance funnel with per-step drop-off tooltip (From Step N: conversion / drop-off %) (step 8).
avoid: Insights sample-dataset / Upgrade banner as the end of authoring (steps 6–8) — Essentials should not gate pre-brief completion stats behind a paywall empty state.
mobbin:9b7b370a-b591-4494-b083-228f11e6f.fit: Extends today's Briefing tab video into the planned interactive orientation/pre-brief maker (step outline + hotspots); Preview feature toggles map to what learners see before a session — clash if we copy Arcade's product-demo Insights/CTA chrome wholesale.

mobbin:644ef98c-516f-47e4-97e5-ee9ce4635.summary: On a demo step the user edits hotspot callout text, generates a voiceover from that script, then reviews the synced Voiceover AI waveform timeline with Edit voiceover.
steal: Written callout text is the single source for Generate voiceover (step 1) — one script drives caption and audio.
Hotspot style triad Hotspot / Area / Callout plus Open by default (step 1).
Destination dropdown on the hotspot for jump-to-step branching (step 1).
Voiceover AI bottom timeline with waveform, duration, and Edit voiceover after generation (step 2).
mobbin:644ef98c-516f-47e4-97e5-ee9ce4635.fit: Supports the new interactive orientation maker with per-step narration; also a scripts pattern (written cue → optional audio) without building a Maestro-style state editor.
